01.name: Reimu Hakurei
01.title: Shrine Maiden of Paradise
01.description:
A scarlet mist hangs over Gensokyo. While Reimu would usually
			enjoy the change from the hot Summer weather, the lack of sun is
			concerning for both humans and youkai alike. This lazy girl must
			now set out to fix this anomaly.
01.description_extra:
The skies have been cleared. While Reimu would usually start 
			lazing about after a hard day's work, it appears the mistress
			of the mansion believes there are some property damages that
			need to be paid for. To avoid another temper tantrum from starting,
			Reimu heads to the manor's basement for a new incident.
01.description_phantasm:
An aura of evil permeates the land; the sky darkens and the sun
			turns a menacing and unnatural shade. Reimu equips her most powerful
			tools and talismans to defeat whatever demon has invaded Gensokyo...
01.manual:
Reimu is an all rounder character good for beginners with average
			damage shots guaranteed to hit their target.

02.name: Marisa Kirisame
02.title: Ordinary Witch of the Woods
02.description:
A scarlet mist hangs over Gensokyo. The Forest of Magic is
			more dark and forboding than ever, and on top of that, the air
			is hard to breathe. To fix this situation developing outside her
			house, Marisa goes out to solve the incident.
02.description_extra:
The skies have been cleared. Marisa is happy to continue her
			daily routine of whichcraft without breathing problems, but
			the resident magician appears indignant over 'stolen property'.
			She is however, willing to forgive the rookie theif, but for
			a price. Marisa heads down to the basement to negotiate.
02.description_phantasm:
On a routine ingredient gathering trip, the world goes dark
			around the ordinary magician. Realizing that something serious 
			and unseen has occured near her home, Marisa drops her bags
			of herbs and mushrooms to investigate the anomaly.
02.manual:
Marisa is a fast and high damage fighter good for skilled players,
			though she requires close range to take advantage of abilities.

03.name: Rin Satsuki
03.title: Regular Village Girl
03.description:
A scarlet mist hangs over Gensokyo. With the schoolhouse closed
			due to the strange weather and the children sent home, Rin is left
			with nothing to do. While out of her league and job description,
			she ventures out to resolve the situation herself.
03.description_extra:
The skies have been cleared. Rin looks forward to the village's
			days to return to normal and is even happy to greet her new foreign
			neighbors despite previous misgivings. However, during the
			introductions, it appears the mistress of the manor believes that 
			Rin's work at the school apparently qualifies her to work as an
			inpromptu babysitter. With a hefty paycheck, Rin is sent down
			to the basement.
03.description_phantasm:
When the sky turned an unnatural shade of black for the second time
			in days, the whole village went into lockdown. Vilage heads and commoners
			alike huddle in their homes; Rin, riding high from her recent adventure
			in the manor, goes out resolve this new incident.
03.manual:
Rin is a slow paced character without a focus shot and instead builds
			up power over time to augment a wide shot range.
